=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
Line or code reference: lines 1584, 1775, 1778 (jq expressions)
Problem: The jq job-selection filter uses `test("codex-agent")`, which can match unintended job names containing that substring.
Why it fails at runtime: This can select the wrong job when multiple names contain `codex-agent`, causing the wait loop to follow a non-reviewer job. The regex is unanchored and could match job names like `my-codex-agent-wrapper` or `codex-agent-helper`, leading to incorrect job selection.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
**CORRECTNESS & LOGIC**
File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
Line or code reference: lines 1577-1587 (and duplicated at ~1762, ~1768) — the jq expression:
`([.jobs[] | select(.name | test("codex-agent"))] | last | .id) // ([.jobs[] | select(.status == "in_progress")] | last | .id) // .jobs[0].id // empty`
Problem: `test("codex-agent")` is an unanchored substring match.
Why it fails at runtime: If a future job name contains "codex-agent" as a substring (e.g. "review / codex-agent-wrapper" or similar), or if job ordering changes, the selector could pick the wrong job ID. The live-log shortcut and LOG_SIZE probe would then read the wrong log, breaking early-success detection, activity signals, and the per-step stall deferral logic that this PR was written to fix. This matches the exact concern raised by mistralai/mistral-small-2603 in the cross-pollination consensus (high severity).
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
